messages:
Maya - Marketing: Heads up: webinar is Tue 4/15 10am PT. We need the social schedule (X + LI), CTA copy variants, asset owners, and SDR routing. Can someone lead the schedule?
Alex - Growth: Ill take scheduling. Want to A/B CTA + pinned reply experiment on X. Need final copy by Monday EOD.
Sam - Content: Drafts are almost there. Two thread concepts: (A) benchmark story emphasizing cost/latency, (B) narrative-led product walkthrough. Suggest LI gets the benchmark, X gets the product walkthrough with GIF/clip.
Maya - Marketing: Agreed. Benchmark on LI during noon ET peak. X thread at 9:30am PT. Reminder tweet 30m before.
Sam - Content: Assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood/WEB-064 (GIF, 60s clip, carousel). Filenames labeled: WEB-064-gif, WEB-064-clip, WEB-064-carousel. I added alt text and suggested live-reply options.
Alex - Growth: Schedule plan: 
X thread: 2026-04-15T09:30:00-07:00
LinkedIn post: 2026-04-15T12:00:00-04:00
X reminder: 2026-04-15T09:00:00-07:00 (pinned reply posted at T+2m if we test).
Rachel - SDR Ops: For inbound routing: ensure registration includes utm_source=social, utm_campaign=amplify_ripple, utm_content={creative}. Add hidden field channel=social. I'll route to #sdr-webinars and tag high-priority leads as webinar_high.
Alex - Growth: Can we add creative tokens so clicks can be traced to gif/clip/carousel? Use utm_content=gif|clip|carousel.
Sam - Content: Done. Ive appended creative tokens to each CTA link. Also prepared two CTA lines for X: 1) Direct: "Sign up -> [link]" 2) Curiosity: "See why inference cost matters  register".
Maya - Marketing: Good. Engagement plan: live replies during webinar (Sam to monitor), 24hr recap post with short clip + transcript, and nurture email to registrants. Rachel, what's SDR follow-up cadence?
Rachel - SDR Ops: 24h: outreach email + LinkedIn connect if they opened recap. 72h: phone outreach for those flagged hot. Auto-tag attendees who asked Qs as "hot". I'll share templates after testing webhook.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Finalize social copy" in #marketing at 2026-04-13T17:00:00Z.
Alex - Growth: One more: if we want paid boosts after 2h of organic, I need approval today. Maya, can you confirm budget floor?
Maya - Marketing: Approve up to $1k boost if we see strong CTRs in first 90m. Notify me.
Sam - Content: Uploading alternative openers and suggested thread reply scripts now. Also adding flagged lines for pinned-reply test.
Rachel - SDR Ops: I'll test webhook today at 4pm with staging payload and report results. Will add dedupe by email and ignore bot test leads.
Maya - Marketing: Final checklist: Sam final copy Monday EOD, Alex schedules, Rachel confirms webhook & templates, ops-bot reminder in place. Thanks team  we'll do a quick standup Monday AM if anything changes.
